title: Variable injectivity within CNF clauses
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $cs$ be a list of normal-form OR circuits on $n$ variables. Suppose every member of $cs$ is a base OR-clause whose circuit literals have pairwise distinct variable indices. In every clause of the CNF obtained from the AND-node over $cs$, any two literals with the same variable are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of normal-form OR circuits on $n$ variables
Every member of $cs$ is a base OR-clause
The variable indices of the circuit literals in each such clause are pairwise distinct
The two literals occur in the same clause of the resulting CNF and have the same variable
replaced:
Let $cs$ be a list of normal-form OR circuits on $n$ variables, and suppose every member
of $cs$ is a base OR-clause: for each $c \in cs$ there is a list of circuit literals
$lits$, whose variable indices are pairwise distinct, with $c = \mathrm{clause}\,lits$.
Form the CNF formula of the AND-node over $cs$ by converting each of these OR-clauses
into a term. Then within any single clause of this CNF, any two literals that share the
same variable are identical — in particular they carry the same negation flag.
